MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
NEUTRAL: normal volatility at 28.9% with narrow participation; only 1/8 sectors posted a positive 1W return. Breadth is weak, so the regime label masks a broadly negative tape.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Transportation led, with 1W +0.60% but 1M -5.45%—a sector-level RECOVERY. Holding & Investment and Banking & Finance were the least weak next, but both remain BELOW TREND on negative 1W and 1M returns.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology & Telecom was weakest (1W: -8.51% | 1M: -15.27%), followed by Construction & REIT (1W: -6.36% | 1M: -7.78%); both are BELOW TREND. Energy & Chemicals also lagged (1W: -6.34% | 1M: -12.04%), BELOW TREND.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
TAVHL (1W: +6.71% | 1M: +3.17%) ABOVE TREND; SAHOL (1W: +4.14% | 1M: -1.49%) RECOVERY; GARAN (1W: +2.51% | 1M: +1.13%) ABOVE TREND. HALKB (1W: +0.96% | 1M: -6.18%) RECOVERY; YKBNK (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +0.22%) ABOVE TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
KONTR (1W: -21.72% | 1M: -39.45%), TKFEN (1W: -15.79% | 1M: -18.43%), VESTL (1W: -11.61% | 1M: -30.72%), TOASO (1W: -8.75% | 1M: -18.03%), and TRMET (1W: -9.25% | 1M: -5.47%) are all BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
TAVHL (1W: +6.71% | 1M: +3.17%) ABOVE TREND leads weekly momentum; SAHOL (1W: +4.14% | 1M: -1.49%) RECOVERY follows. GARAN (1W: +2.51% | 1M: +1.13%) ABOVE TREND also shows positive follow-through.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
GARAN (1W: +2.51% | 1M: +1.13%) and YKBNK (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +0.22%) are ABOVE TREND, while ISCTR (1W: +0.23% | 1M: -3.54%) is in RECOVERY. AKBNK (1W: -0.65% | 1M: -5.73%) remains BELOW TREND; sector returns are negative across both periods.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
The sector remains weak: EREGL (1W: -0.21% | 1M: -0.54%), FROTO (1W: -5.78% | 1M: -12.07%), and TOASO (1W: -8.75% | 1M: -18.03%) are all BELOW TREND. ASELS (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -9.33%) is also BELOW TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Pressure is broad: TUPRS (1W: -6.16% | 1M: -11.15%), SASA (1W: -6.45% | 1M: -24.68%), and GUBRF (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -14.90%) are all BELOW TREND. SISE (1W: -4.33% | 1M: -10.21%) is also BELOW TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Stay defensive and selective; weak breadth and negative returns across seven sectors argue against broad risk-taking despite the NEUTRAL regime label. Favor relative strength and require improving participation before adding exposure; all sector quant screens are disqualified on negative 2W returns.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
Track TAVHL (1W: +6.71% | 1M: +3.17%) and GARAN (1W: +2.51% | 1M: +1.13%), both ABOVE TREND, for follow-through. SAHOL (1W: +4.14% | 1M: -1.49%) is a RECOVERY candidate; watch whether the weekly bounce persists.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Monitor Transportation for confirmation of its positive 1W performance despite a negative 1M trend. Banking & Finance is also worth watching for stabilization, while Technology & Telecom remains the weakest sector.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Specific XU100 support and resistance levels were not provided. Key triggers are a broader sector participation rebound and volatility moving above 40% or back below 25%.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

The market is NEUTRAL by the supplied regime classification, but normal volatility at 28.9% and breadth of just 1/8 point to narrow, fragile participation. Transportation and select banking names show relative strength, while technology, industrials, and energy remain under pressure; favor a defensive stance pending broader confirmation.
